fontWeight._note: These track live edits to the shared Figma text styles and have flipped more than once - re-check get_variable_defs before trusting this table. Current: Display XL = Regular (400); H1, H2 & H3 = Medium (500); H4 = Regular (400). H3 was 400 (Regular) at 32px until the latest edit changed the 'HEADER/H3' style itself to Medium (500) at 40px - it's now shared by the sidebar name and work-card-title.

h3.note: HOME sidebar name. The Hover-state Figma frames for work-card-title still show this size, but per explicit user direction the card title stays at h4 (below) in both default and hover states - only the awards/program panel appears on hover, the title itself doesn't resize.

h4.note: was size 24; work-card-title, same size in both default and hover states.

bodySmall.note: 'PARA/Body' (471:1204 HOME): TikTok Sans 16px, letterSpacing 0. Used for sidebar location/role/bio/nav/contact copy, work-card meta/description, and (as of the latest footer edit) the footer nav row too, which moved off the 'subheader' style below. Figma's reported lineHeight 100 means 'Auto', not a literal 1.0 - confirmed by this style exporting as leading-normal everywhere it's used.

bodyAlt.note: Source Sans 3 case-study 'Body' style. No longer used on the redesigned HOME page (see bodySmall above); kept for whenever those case-study pages are built.

subheader.note: lineHeight corrected from 1 to 'normal', same Figma 'Auto' convention as bodySmall above. No longer used anywhere on HOME as of the latest footer edit (footer nav moved to bodySmall/TikTok Sans instead); kept for whenever a case study using it is built.

workCard.note: HOME work-card (471:1204); both padding and gap are off the base scale. Gap was 40, tightened to 20 as of the latest edit

sidebar.note: HOME sidebar (471:1204): Figma stacks [intro, divider, nav, contact] as one flat flex column with a single uniform 40px gap (innerGap) throughout - no separate 'outer' gap pushing contact to the bottom of a viewport-height sidebar (an earlier build artificially stretched the sidebar to 100vh for that; removed). introGap is name-to-bio, also 40px.

navPill.note: HOME nav-links pill: the pill container itself gained 16px vertical padding as of the latest menu edit, while each row's own vertical padding tightened from 16 to 12. Nav items are also bold now (were regular) and no longer uppercase or arrow-suffixed - text reads 'Works' / 'About me' / 'Playground *coming soon*' in natural case.

footer.note: HOME footer (490:2544): outerGap separates [icons+name+nav block], divider, and copyright - was 40, tightened to 20 as of the latest edit. Social icons scaled to 70% of their prior 48px size (33.6px), gap scaled with them (8 -> 5.6).
